verdicts.reason: Both candidates are visually identical. Both have the same flaws: the can sits in the upper part of the brown circle, leaving its lower half as empty dead space. The SOLSTICE logo is placed beside the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' and competes with it, instead of sitting apart as a brand sign-off. There is also a large, unbalanced gap between the quote mark and the quote text, and the quote block is not vertically centred against the circle.
